name: Soul Extractor
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 7th; Slot none; Price 250 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This crystal wrapped in a filigree cage of precious metals is flat on one side, as if it were designed to be placed on a surface. When placed upon a creature, the filigree unfolds and pins itself to the creature’s flesh.

A soul extractor can be used to extract magical enhancements from a creature’s soul and their veils, allowing a creature to recover the gold they have invested by enhancing their veils, or allowing you to extract the enhancements from a corpse’s veils.

The soul extractor must be applied to a willing, helpless, or dead creature in a process that takes 1 hour. The soul extractor can only be used on a corpse that has died within 7 days. The creature or corpse must have a veil known with the [Enhanced] descriptor which they have enhanced, or an ability that can be enhanced as if it had the [Enhanced] descriptor. Attempting to apply the soul extractor to such a creature causes it to faintly glow, allowing you to easily determine if they have a valid enhancement for the item to extract.

After this hour, you choose one of those veils or abilities and the soul extractor draws the enhancements from the veil or ability, removing those abilities and producing a brightly glowing powder of equal value to the crafting cost of those enhancements. If you do not know the creature’s enhanced veils or abilities, one is extracted at random. This powder can be sold at its full value, or used as a reagent when crafting magic items or enhancing weapons or armor.

If one of the affected creature’s veils or abilities was enhanced multiple times, the soul extractor only removes one enhancement of your choice applied to that veil or ability with each use. If you do not know the specific enhancements applied to that veil or ability, the soul extractor extracts one at random.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells dispel magic; Cost 125 gp
